name: CALL THE KILL
text: The Kill-Broker's strategic gambit, free of command points while it is in the killzone. Pick any enemy operative in the killzone as the mark until the end of the turning point.

name: CUT-THROATS
text: This turning point, friendly Farstalker melee weapons get +1 Atk, to at most 5.

name: ROGUE
text: This turning point, whenever any operative shoots a friendly Farstalker operative the shooter's weapon loses Saturate, and a defender that can retain cover saves may retain one more, or retain one as a critical success. It does not stack with the improvement from Vantage terrain.

name: PREY
text: This turning point, a friendly Farstalker operative that shoots in an activation in which it has not Charged, Fallen Back or Repositioned has Balanced and Severe on its ranged weapons; a weapon that already has Balanced gets Ceaseless and Severe instead.

name: BOUND
text: This turning point, in each friendly Farstalker operative's activation, the first 2 inches of vertical distance of one climb up is ignored.

name: SAVAGE AMBUSH
text: When an enemy takes the Fight action against a ready friendly Farstalker operative that has Light or Heavy terrain in its control range, the defender resolves first in that sequence.

name: SLIP AWAY
text: During a friendly Farstalker operative's activation, before or after an action: for the rest of the activation, Fall Back costs it 1 less AP.

name: POACH
text: During a friendly Farstalker operative's activation: until it ends, Pick Up Marker and mission actions that need control of a marker need only contest it.

name: VENGEANCE FOR THE KINBAND
text: When a friendly Farstalker operative is incapacitated by an enemy operative: for the rest of the battle other friendly Farstalker weapons have Relentless against that enemy. It cannot be used again until that enemy has been incapacitated.
